photos.title: File:Chloris verticillata - windmillgrass - 51679981431.jpg
photos.description:
Collected in 2017 just south of Miles City at the Custer County Cemetery. The Custer County Extension agent says they have
been mistaking this grass for Digitaria (crabgrass).
